config.spread_definition: Standard deviation of unbounded offsets in degrees. Laplace scale = radians(spread)/sqrt(2); Gaussian SD = radians(spread).
config.angle_boundary: Reflect into [-pi/2,pi/2] using arcsin(sin(theta)); preserves steering and, for symmetric offsets and uniform centres, uniform marginal angles.
config.channel_normalization: sqrt(32/40) sum of 40 unnormalized steering vectors times independent CN(0,1) path gains; expected per-entry power32. No per-draw norm rescaling.
config.covariance_estimate: One global zero-mean spatial covariance per generator, pooled across the four identically distributed users of 20,000 independent MIMO draws (80,000 vectors). Separate user covariances also retained. No validation or confirmation channel contributes.
config.lmmse: Genie observes complex Y-B. Exact linear posterior estimate using the empirical global spatial covariance and full pilot Gram matrix, including its off-diagonal entries. It does not know the current channel's cluster centres or DoAs.

rank_definitions.conditional: Per-user steering matrix numerical rank (max(M,40)*eps*smax); effective ranks from its squared singular values, equivalent to conditional channel covariance given DoAs.
rank_definitions.global: Numerical and power effective ranks of the separately estimated population covariance.
rank_definitions.effective: Entropy rank exp(-sum(p log p)), p=eigenvalues/sum; also participation ratio 1/sum(p^2).
rank_definitions.channel_matrix: M-by-K H matrix ranks also reported; a single channel vector itself has rank1.

config.classical_initialization: CN(0,1), identical across all estimators, generators and cells within a split.

classical_tolerance.points: Both GS100 and EM100 at all five Fig3 SNRs and six Fig4 pilot counts; shared P20/SNR5 retains both published readings.

config.lmmse_pass: Mean-linear NMSE converted to dB must reach or beat every requested target: Fig3 SNR5 and20 and all six Fig4 pilot values. No digitization allowance in the primary gate; report +/-0.2dB sensitivity separately.
config.selection: Validation only. Among clustered generators passing both gates, choose smallest worst target gap, then mean gap, then name. If none passes, choose the closest nonpassing clustered generator among those passing classical tolerance for an explicitly negative confirmation; if none meets classical tolerance, choose lowest classical RMSE. Confirm only that fixed candidate and independent-ray control on 2,000 new draws. No re-selection from confirmation.
config.training_gate: Proceed only if the validation-selected clustered generator passes both gates on validation and confirmation. Otherwise do not run overfit or neural training. If it passes, run the requested 64-sample test then v3/v1 training, three seeds,20k samples,50epochs, with separate neural training/validation/test splits.
config.protected: Entire urformer_snr_audit directory and its selected protected earlier sources/results/checkpoints. All new files stay in urformer_cluster_audit.

verdicts.published_URformer_gain_is_caused_by_clu: inconclusive; a nonlinear estimator can exploit per-channel cluster structure that global LMMSE cannot use

task4.reason: No clustered generator passes the requested combined classical-match and global-covariance LMMSE gate.

estimator_scope: The locked configuration uses the phrase linear posterior. The implemented estimator is linear MMSE from second moments, not the exact Bayesian posterior mean for the non-Gaussian clustered-channel mixture. It minimizes ordinary MSE within the linear class; evaluation uses mean per-channel NMSE.
